llc.formation_doc: Articles of Organization - Limited Liability Company (Form SS-4270)
llc.formation_notes: $50 per member in existence on the filing date, minimum $300, maximum $3,000 (so $300 for 1-6 members). $300 flat if the articles prohibit doing business in Tennessee.

annual_report.name: Annual Report
annual_report.due: on or before the first day of the fourth month after the close of the LLC's fiscal year
annual_report.late_penalty: failure to file can lead to administrative dissolution; fee rises $50 per member above 6, max $3,000; +$20 if registered agent/office changed

state_tax_on_llc.name: Franchise tax
state_tax_on_llc.applies: LLCs doing business in Tennessee, including single-member LLCs owned by an individual (not disregarded for F&E) unless an obligated member entity
state_tax_on_llc.notes: 0.25% ($0.25 per $100) of Tennessee net worth, $100 minimum. Public Chapter 950 (2024) repealed the property ('minimum') measure for tax years ending on or after January 1, 2024; base is now net worth only.

state_tax_on_llc.name: Excise tax
state_tax_on_llc.applies: net earnings of LLCs doing business in Tennessee (entity-level, even if federal pass-through)
state_tax_on_llc.notes: 6.5% of Tennessee taxable income. A DOR workshop deck (08/25/2026) reportedly mentions a 5.5% rate for certain pass-through entities - not verified.

notable: An LLC pays franchise ($100 minimum) and excise tax at entity level even when it is a single-member LLC disregarded federally, unless it is an obligated member entity (https://www.tn.gov/revenue/taxes/franchise---excise-tax.html)

Franchise tax property measure repealed by Public Chapter 950 (2024) for tax years ending on or after 2024-01-01; refund window closed in late 2024 (https://www.tn.gov/content/dam/tn/revenue/documents/notices/fae/24-05fe.pdf)
LLC formation and annual report fees are per member: $300 minimum, $3,000 maximum (https://sos.tn.gov/businesses/faqs)
No tax on wages or self-employment income; Hall tax on interest/dividends gone since 2021
